title: Vulkan: Update all components to Vulkan SDK 1.4.335.0
body:
Needs to be tested on all platforms where we support Vulkan, but also D3D12 and Metal for SPIR-V.
Our last sync was almost 2 years ago so this is long overdue, and thus would be good to include in 4.6.

Updated:
- vulkan headers
- volk
- glslang
- spirv-headers
- spirv-cross
- spirv-reflect
- vk_mem_alloc 3.3.0

TODO:
- [x] SPIRV-Reflect not updated yet as they implemented support for specialization constants which conflicts with our patches, so this needs some work to use the new upstream API if suitable.
@DarioSamo Would you be able to take a look at doing the SPIRV-Reflect update as a PR/direct push to my branch?
*Edit:* Done, thanks Darío!
- [x] VulkanMemoryAllocator not updated as it's not versioned together with the SDK, and it often requires more work.
Could be done in a separate PR if that sounds reasonable, or in this PR if we risk having issues by sticking to an older version.
*Edit:* Done, we can remove it if it causes issues.
- [x] Update MoltenVK for official builds. WIP in https://github.com/godotengine/moltenvk-osxcross/pull/5.
*Edit:* Done with https://github.com/godotengine/godot-build-scripts/pull/143.

Supersedes #107773.
